source.attribution: 국토지리정보원, 브이월드 행정경계(시군구), CC BY 2.0 KR. Petasos에서 EPSG:5179 좌표를 EPSG:4326으로 변환하고 지역별 형상 파일로 분리했습니다. 경계의 단순화·수정은 하지 않았습니다.
source.reviewBasis: VWorld dataset 30252 lists CC BY 2.0 KR for this download. User supplied original ZIP and schema PDF; hashes verified. PDF p136: N3A_G0100000, BJCD CHAR10 legal code, DIVI city/county/gu. XML EPSG:5179 and PRJ agree. All 264 BJCD suffixes are 00000; first five digits mapped without discarding city/gu overlaps. File dates do not establish the legal effective date. Geometry use only; region confirmation policy and actual location quality remain pending.
